As a result git.call(null, ['update-ref',...]) in guardCommit (cold hook), run.call/Reflect.apply(run, ...) with push --force in verifyForbiddenPhase02Diff, and git.call/Reflect.apply/array-stored git in check-evidence-relocation all scan as 0 sites on a HEAD copy. The general scanner flags the same escapes as unresolved-binary. Fix: return flow.escapes from declaredSiteId and refuse non-configured-binary declarations whose wrapper escapes; add .call/Reflect.apply/array-stored callers to the WRAPPERS test; amend the spec sentence.
